# Construction Dive

> Construction Dive is a digital publication covering news, trends, and analysis in the construction industry with security infrastructure powered by Cloudflare.

Construction Dive delivers breaking news, in-depth analysis, and industry insights for construction professionals. The site uses modern web security and performance technologies to protect user data and ensure reliable access.

## Key Topics

- Construction Industry News
- Cloudflare Security
- Bot Protection
- Email Protection
- Web Security
- Construction Technology
- Industry Analysis
- Construction Trends
- Digital Infrastructure
- Email Obfuscation

## Security & Infrastructure

- [Email Protection](https://www.constructiondive.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection): Cloudflare email protection service that obfuscates email addresses and protects against malicious bots and spam
